recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結結構保留，濾泡之間的竇被大片淡染的組織球擴張成蒼白區域，與深藍色濾泡形成明暗交錯、被膜增厚纖維化，符合 Rosai-Dorfman 病的竇擴張樣式。
features: Low-power lymph node with preserved but distorted architecture
Pale-staining, markedly dilated sinuses filled with histiocytes separating dark lymphoid follicles
Scattered residual follicles, some with germinal centers
Thickened fibrotic capsule and fibrous bands at the periphery
Cellular detail (emperipolesis) not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power view of a lymph node shows preserved but distorted architecture with marked sinus dilation. The sinuses are expanded by pale-staining sheets of histiocytes, producing a light-and-dark pattern against residual dark-staining lymphoid follicles. The capsule is thickened and fibrotic. Higher power is required to assess emperipolesis. Findings are suggestive of sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy (Rosai-Dorfman disease), pending S100 immunostaining.

ddx.vs: Reactive sinus histiocytosis rarely produces such massive sinus distension with capsular fibrosis and lacks large S100-positive histiocytes with emperipolesis.
LCH also involves sinuses but shows grooved nuclei, eosinophils and necrosis with CD1a/langerin positivity.
Metastatic carcinoma forms cohesive atypical epithelial nests that are keratin positive rather than bland histiocytes.

ddx.dx: Lymphadenopathy in Whipple disease or mycobacterial infection
ddx.vs: Infectious histiocytic lesions show foamy PAS-positive or AFB-positive histiocytes or granulomas rather than S100-positive emperipolesis-rich cells.
